Hi Judy — thanks for the clear questions. Quick answers up front, details below and I'll attach the documents you can share with procurement.

High level:
- Our SOC 2 Type II report covers Redwood-managed control environment (Hosted + Redwood Dedicated where the control plane and certain infrastructure components remain under Redwood operational control).
- Customer-managed Private deployments (self-hosted on-prem or fully customer-managed VPCs where the customer controls networking and key management) are not covered by the standard SOC 2 report — those are considered out of scope because control ownership shifts.
- We can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter confirming no material changes to the control environment since the last report for the period you specified; we can also provide a controls-mapping workbook that explicitly calls out which controls are Redwood responsibilities vs customer responsibilities for Dedicated vs Private.

Deliverables I will send now (redacted where applicable):
1) Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_2024.pdf (redacted) — covers Hosted + Redwood-managed Dedicated.
2) bridge-letter-template.docx — draft wording we can sign.
3) infrastructure-scope-matrix.xlsx — control ownership by deployment mode (columns: Control, Hosted, Dedicated-managed, Dedicated-customer-managed, Private/VPC, On-prem).

To be explicit: for Dedicated instances where customers ask to manage their own KMS/networking (i.e., customer-managed Dedicated), some technical controls transfer to the customer; in those cases we will annotate the SOC coverage gaps and recommend compensating controls and evidence types. For Private/on-prem, we will not assert control coverage in the SOC; instead we provide the mapping + suggested attestation language your auditors can use.

Next steps:

- If you confirm Acme needs the bridge letter covering through 2025-12-31, Marissa (cc'd) from our contracts team will coordinate signature and timeline.
- If your audit team needs a call to walk the controls matrix, we can do a 30-min working session — propose Thu or Fri this week.
